Meet the Barbers

The Team Behind The Fade Cave

Passionate barbers, quality cuts and a commitment to helping every client leave feeling their best.

Owner & Founder

Leanne

Leanne is the owner and founder of The Fade Cave. With 7 years of experience in the barbering industry and 3 years of experience teaching barbering, she brings a wealth of knowledge, skill and passion to both her clients and students.

Leanne is passionate about delivering high-quality barbering while helping the next generation of barbers build their confidence, technique and career.

Barber

Aoife

Aoife has been barbering for 18 months and is continuing to grow her skills while building her own loyal client base at The Fade Cave.

Trained by Leanne, Aoife has developed a strong foundation in modern barbering and is passionate about creating clean, fresh cuts while giving every client a great experience. She is constantly learning, improving and growing as a barber.

16-Week Beginner Barbering Course

Beginner Barbering Course

Start your barbering journey with The Fade Cave Academy. 💈

Our 16-week beginner barbering course is designed to take you from complete beginner to confident barber, with hands-on training and expert guidance every step of the way.

You’ll receive a full professional barbering kit to use throughout your training, giving you everything you need to practise and develop your skills.

You’ll be trained by Leanne Mooney, an experienced barber with 7 years in the barbering industry, who will teach you the techniques, knowledge and confidence needed to succeed.

What you’ll learn:

  • ✂️ All aspects of barbering
  • 💈 Skin fades & fades
  • ✂️ Scissor work & cutting techniques
  • 🪒 Beard trims & shaping
  • 💇‍♂️ Different styles and finishes
  • 🧴 Hair & beard preparation
  • 📐 Blending, detailing & precision work
  • 🤝 Client consultation & customer service
  • 🧼 Hygiene, tools & professional standards
  • 📱 Building confidence as a working barber

16 weeks. One full kit. Expert training. Your barbering career starts here. 💈🔥

Fade Master Class

Fade Master Class

Take your fades to the next level and learn how to guard skip and fade flawlessly. ✂️🔥

Our Fade Master Class breaks down the techniques behind clean, seamless fades, helping you understand guidelines, blending, clipper control, guard skipping and finishing.

Perfect your technique, improve your confidence and learn how to create sharp, smooth fades every time.

6-Week Introduction to Barbering Course

Introduction to Barbering

Not sure if barbering is the right career for you? ✂️ Our 6-week Introduction to Barbering Course is the perfect way to find out!

Designed for complete beginners, this course gives you the opportunity to experience the world of barbering before fully committing to a career or longer-term training.

Over the 6 weeks, you’ll learn the fundamentals of barbering through hands-on training, including clipper work, scissor techniques, blending, fading, beard trimming, styling and finishing.

You’ll also gain an insight into what it’s really like to work in a barbershop, while building your confidence and developing practical skills along the way.

Whether you’re simply curious about barbering, considering a career change, or want to see if you have what it takes to become a barber, this course allows you to try it before you commit.

  • ✂️ 6 weeks of hands-on training
  • 🎓 Perfect for complete beginners
  • 💈 Ideal for anyone unsure if barbering is for them

Try barbering. Learn the skills. Discover if it’s for you.
